mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market deterioration signaled by unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE >= 5.0%) and ultra-low interest rates (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) signals a stagflationary risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE >= 5.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, elevated residential sales (RSAFS > 450,000) indicate overheating in the housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO above 100.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1150 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1150.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market mismatch characterized by rising employment (PAYEMS > 143,000) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates economic fragility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 143000 and UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) signals persistent price pressures that lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 during monetary tightening cycles.
